title: Taiwan Night Market Sweet Potato Doughnut Holes Recipe (Sweet Potato Balls 地瓜球)
description:
Here's how to make those awesome sweet potato balls found at Taiwan Night Markets.

Ingredients:
3/4 cup Sweet potato flour http://amzn.to/2c2GjDL
I've never used this brand flour before so can't confirm it will be ok
Cooking Oil
1 tsp granulated sugar
8 oz White sweet potato
